description: This Java source file defines the DeviceListFragment class, a ListFragment that displays available Wi-Fi Direct peers, manages peer discovery, and handles user interactions in an Android Wi-Fi Direct demo app.

classes.name: DeviceListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays available Wi-Fi Direct peers and manages peer discovery and user interactions.

classes.name: DeviceActionListener
classes.description: Interface for activity to handle device interaction events such as showing details, connecting, disconnecting.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter with the list of peers.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a string representing the device's connection status.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a peer in the list to show details.

methods.name: updateThisDevice
methods.description: Updates UI with the current device's name and status.

methods.name: onPeersAvailable
methods.description: Updates the peer list when new peers are discovered.

methods.name: onInitiateDiscovery
methods.description: Starts peer discovery and shows a progress dialog.
